culture.text: About 40,000+ students, 6,000 staff and 3,000 PhD candidates, making it one of Amsterdam's biggest employers.
Staff fields lean social sciences and humanities: psychology, economics, political science, history and sociology.
Says it offers an open, creative and international work climate with excellent employment conditions.

open.text: It is not listed in the IND recognised sponsor data we hold.

growth.text: Has an annual budget of more than €850 million.

worth_knowing.text: Apologised for firing Jewish staff during the Second World War.
Banned laptops and phones from a lecture hall.
